headline: 13 NEAR-chain contracts/accounts catalogued from Rhea's official contracts doc (LST core: lst.rhealab.near); 1 DAO governor and 12 protocol/token contracts; 2 non-NEAR addresses recorded.

findings.text: Direct explorer name-tag search was not completed. Nearblocks was reached only through search grounding. That search returned a token page for lst.rhealab.near (Rhea Liquid Near Staking Token, rNEAR) and one for token.rhealab.near (RHEA). The nearblocks content was only a partial snippet. The addresses are therefore backed by the fetched official docs, not by nearblocks.

The official contracts page at guide.rhea.finance/developers/contracts.md was fetched. It lists NEAR mainnet accounts for tokens, protocol contracts, legacy Ref contracts and testnet counterparts. The LST contract is lst.rhealab.near ('Manage rNEAR token'). It also lists two non-NEAR addresses: the BSC bridged RHEA token and an Aurora aggregator contract.

The audits index page was fetched. It lists Resonance (2025-10-09, Liquid Staking Protocol), BlockSec (2025-08-05, rNEAR contract) and Trail of Bits (2025-02-19, Farming/AMM/Stable/ALMM/CLMM/Token). The report PDFs were not opened, so no in-scope address tables were extracted.

Search surfaced github.com/ref-finance/rnear-contract (Rust, contracts/ folder) and github.com/rhea-finance/rnear-sdk. No deployment-artifact files (broadcast, deployments, addresses.json) were walked, and no commit SHA was pinned.

The protocol lists a single chain, NEAR. The docs state all RHEA contracts are on NEAR and that BSC and Solana RHEA tokens are bridged representations. The BSC bridged-token and Aurora aggregator addresses are recorded with their own chain labels.

No factory contracts were identified for the LST. v2.ref-finance.near is an AMM exchange whose pools are not enumerable through the defipunkd read API, which does not support NEAR. No children were enumerated.

Roles were assigned from the docs' 'Type' and 'Mission' columns. These are tentative classifications. Actor classes are 'unknown' because no NEAR account code or keys were read, except the DAO, which the docs describe as the governance owner.

Every address in admin_addresses traces to the fetched contracts doc or the fetched guardians doc. The sputnik DAO account is also named in the guardians doc. The nearblocks transaction snippet that mentions it is not used as evidence.

rationale.verdict: Discovery slice, so grade is unknown. I walked the official docs (contracts, audits, guardians, bug bounty, LST guide), GitHub org listings and search-grounded nearblocks snippets, and catalogued 13 NEAR accounts plus 2 non-NEAR addresses. On-chain reads were not possible: the defipunkd API does not support NEAR and nearblocks pages were not fetched directly.

evidence.shows: Probe of protocol.website succeeded. The site describes RHEA as a chain-abstracted liquidity solution. It has a Stake section for NEAR to rNEAR liquid staking and links to Docs, GitHub and Forum.

Audit index. Resonance (2025-10-09, Liquid Staking Protocol), BlockSec (2025-08-05, rNEAR Contract) and Trail of Bits (2025-02-19, Farming/AMM/Stable/ALMM/CLMM/Token). The report PDFs are file embeds that were not opened.
Docs index. It confirms the Contracts, Guardians, Audits, Bug Bounty and NEAR LST pages exist.

Canonical deployed-contracts doc. It lists NEAR accounts including token.rhealab.near, xtoken.rhealab.near, otoken.rhealab.near, lst.rhealab.near (LST Contract, manages rNEAR), v2.ref-finance.near, boostfarm.ref-labs.near, dclv2.ref-labs.near, multica.near, contract.main.burrow.near, orhea-conv.rhealab.near, aggregate-oracle.near and lsd-usdt.rhealab.near. It also lists the BSC bridged RHEA token 0x4c067DE26475E1CeFee8b8d1f6E2266b33a2372E and the Aurora aggregator 0x04dFb979Ffa1Fb08B6e6EF626377161CBB085Cf1. It states there is no timelock and that contracts are upgraded through DAO proposals.

LST description. Staking NEAR into the RHEA contract mints rNEAR, a NEP-141 receipt token. Unstaking is either instant via the DEX or standard after 4 epochs. A weighted validator pool is reviewed by the RHEA DAO. Cross-chain access goes through account-abstraction and sub-account contracts, whose addresses are not given.

Guardians can pause v2.ref-finance.near. Only the contract owner can reactivate it. The owner/DAO is named as ref-finance.sputnik-dao.near. The guardian list is available via the 'metadata' view method on v2.ref-finance.near, which was not read.
The bug bounty program is on Immunefi at immunefi.com/bounty/reffinance/.

Search-grounded snippet only (partial body). It shows lst.rhealab.near labelled as the 'Rhea Liquid Near Staking Token' (rNEAR) contract with 24 decimals. It corroborates the account name already sourced from the docs.
Public Rust repo for the rNEAR LST contract (contracts/ folder, MIT license per the org listing). Seen via search result. No commit SHA pinned.
Org listing with rnear-contract, rhea-sdk and token_locker repos.
NEAR docs list Rhea Finance's mainnet liquid staking account as lst.rhealab.near. This independently corroborates the LST contract account.

unknowns: D1-offchain: no direct fetch of nearblocks.io / nearblocks account pages was completed in this run (fetch budget was spent on the docs). Nearblocks was reached only via search snippets. No on-chain state was read for any account.
D1: defipunkd /api/contract/read, /abi and /safe/owners support EVM chainIds only, so no NEAR account could be probed. No surfacer URLs were pinned.

D3: the Resonance (2025-10), BlockSec (2025-08) and Trail of Bits (2025-02) PDFs were not opened, so no audit-scope address tables were extracted. The PDF URLs are embedded file IDs not exposed in the fetched text.
D4: the ref-finance/rnear-contract repo tree and any deployment artifacts were not walked, and no commit SHA was pinned. The protocol.github field is empty in the context.
D4: the rhea-finance/rnear-sdk repo may hard-code the contract account and code hash. It was not read.
D5: chain Near: LST-specific cross-chain account-abstraction / sub-account contracts, and the 'multica.near' account manager's per-chain deployments, were not enumerated.
D6: no factory-style enumeration was run. Whether LST-related factories exist (for example sub-account factories) was not determined.

D7: the guardian accounts for v2.ref-finance.near were not read, because the 'metadata' view was not called. The owner and guardian set of lst.rhealab.near (docs say rNEAR can pause deposits/staking) was not determined.
D7: the DAO membership and roles of ref-finance.sputnik-dao.near were not read. Whether it is the owner of lst.rhealab.near specifically is not verified.
D8: the validator staking-pool accounts used by the LST were not surfaced. The sputnik DAO 'mint' recipient seen in a nearblocks transaction snippet was not used as evidence.

D2: the Immunefi bounty page, a governance forum URL and a security contact were not fetched. The website footer links to a Forum but the URL was not exposed in the fetched text. Governance token details and RHEA/xRHEA voting rights were not verified.
D2: upgradeability of lst.rhealab.near is not determined. The docs mark it 'Locked: Yes' while also saying contracts are upgraded via DAO proposals, which is ambiguous.

protocol_metadata.about: RHEA LST lets users stake NEAR and receive rNEAR, a NEP-141 receipt token whose value rises against NEAR as validator staking rewards accrue. Users can unstake after about 4 epochs or instantly by swapping on the Rhea DEX for a small fee. Staked NEAR is spread across a weighted set of validators, and rNEAR can be used as collateral in Rhea's lending market.
